Sushanth Kamath
Mumbai | LinkedIn | +91 7892203713 | sushanthkamath99@gmail.com
CAREER PROFILE
Securities settlements & trade operations professional with experience at Northern Trust & BNY Mellon, specializing in cross-border securities settlement, pre-matching, fails management and post-trade exception resolution across APAC, EMEA and NAM markets. Background spans F2B trade lifecycle management, custodian and broker coordination, cash & position reconciliation and SSI interpretation within global market infrastructure and settlement systems. Proficient in SWIFT messaging across securities and payment categories with a consistent focus on settlement risk mitigation, SLA adherence and operational control.
CAREER SUMMARY
Brate Group	Canberra, Australia
Operations Associate - Green Team (Promoted August 2024)	May 2023 - June 2025 Part-time finance and operations role undertaken during full-time postgraduate study at ANU; permanently relocated to Mumbai after graduation.
Performed daily cash reconciliations and shift end financial reporting across multiple sites, recording revenue & investigating variances to maintain strict financial controls and baseline audit readiness.
Collaborated with a 15-member management team to ensure operational continuity and shift governance across a 5-site portfolio, supporting shift governance and service delivery standards.
BNY Mellon	Pune, India
Intermediate Representative, FX - Retail Investigations (Contract)	June 2022 – Oct 2022 Deployed to support a targeted remediation initiative during a period of peak transaction volumes, driving the resolution of FX settlement inquiries to restore service levels and operational control.
Investigated and resolved complex FX settlement fails across EMEA & US markets, coordinating with trading desks and partner institutions to validate trade details and ensure adherence to critical funding deadlines and value date obligations.
Executed and repaired SWIFT payment instructions (MT103, MT202, MT202COV) ensuring compliance with established BAU processing controls, cut-off windows and settlement timelines.
Performed the daily reconciliation of complex cash movements and nostro account positions, resolving ~30-40 high-priority settlement queries and payment exceptions daily within defined SLA parameters.
Identified and documented recurring FX investigation bottlenecks, proposing workflow improvements that contributed to a measurable reduction in exception processing times and overall resolution efficiency.
Northern Trust Corporation	Bengaluru, India
Associate, Global Transitions	May 2019 - Aug 2021
Served as a core execution resource for the Global Transitions team, independently managing high-volume portfolios (~25% of team workload). Recognized as a “Star Performer” (Q1 2021) and recipient of multiple “Celebrate Great” awards for service.
Executed securities settlement and free-of-payment transfers across 40+ international markets across APAC & EMEA, managing institutional portfolios exceeding USD 250M via MT540, MT542 and MT548 messages, coordinating with custodians, brokers & agent banks to ensure timely settlement within cut-off deadlines.
Performed pre-matching validation and fail management across settlement instructions, identifying and resolving mismatches with counterparties ahead of settlement date to minimize failed trades and settlement risk.
Applied market-specific expertise in SSI interpretation, Securities Transaction Taxes across global markets, ensuring compliance with CSDR guidelines and local market settlement rules.
Leveraged SmartStream TLM to perform daily securities and cash reconciliations between internal records and external custodian statements, investigating and resolving breaks while maintaining strict audit traceability for all capital movements.
Coordinated with Onboarding, Customer Data and Fund Accounting teams on quality control and settlement improvement initiatives, contributing to team-wide control enhancement initiatives.
Managed client & investment manager engagement throughout transition planning & delivery, leading calls to align on objectives, proactively surface risks and ensure seamless execution within established SLAs, progressively taking ownership of this client-facing function as responsibilities were transferred from London to Bengaluru.
CORE COMPETENCIES & TECHNICAL SKILLS
Trade Settlement & Custody Operations: FOP Securities Settlement, Pre-Matching & Trade Validation, Fail Management & Buy-in Avoidance, Custody Transitions, In-Specie Transfers, MT540/MT542 Settlement Instructions, MT548 Settlement Status Notifications, MT599 Free Format Messages, Trade Dispute Resolution, SSI Interpretation, Nostro/Stock Reconciliation
Payments & Cash Operations: Multi-Currency Payment Processing, Cash & Position Reconciliation, FX Settlement Investigations, Payment Instruction Confirmation & Repair, MT103, MT202, MT202COV
Operational Controls & Risk Management: Exception Management, Settlement Discrepancy Resolution, Checklist Management, MIS Reporting, SLA Adherence, Escalation Protocols, Root Cause Analysis, Audit & Evidence Support, Change Management
Client & Stakeholder Engagement: Broker & Custodian Liaison, Agent Bank Coordination, Client & Counterparty Support, Query Resolution, Cross-Functional Coordination, Stakeholder Management & Reporting, Training & Knowledge Transfer
Systems & Platforms: SWIFT Messaging Systems, MS Excel (Advanced), MS Office Suite, SmartStream TLM, SharePoint, Power BI, Tableau, Confluence, GenAI Tools (ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini)
Regulatory & Market Frameworks: MiFID, CSDR, Clearstream, CREST, Euroclear, T2S Ecosystem, ASX Clear, HKEX, SGX, Securities Transaction Taxes (STT), DTC/FED Market Exposure
QUALIFICATIONS & TRAINING
Australian National University	Canberra, Australia
Graduate Diploma of Business	Graduation Date: December 2025
Coursework included: Economics, Financial Mathematics, Statistics, Accounting for Sustainability, Corporate Governance, Financial Analysis.
Awards: Research School of Finance, Actuarial Studies and Statistics International Scholarship.
Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE)	Manipal, India
Bachelor of Business Administration (Financial Markets)	Graduation Date: April 2019
Certifications
NSE Certified Capital Market Professional (NCCMP) – National Stock Exchange of India.
Behavioral Finance – Duke University (via Coursera).
LEADERSHIP & COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT
Australian National University – Toad Hall	Canberra, Australia
Senior Residential Mentor	February 2024 – June 2025
Served as the primary point of contact for residents, overseeing floor operations and ensuring strict adherence to university safety protocols and the Code of Conduct.
Delivered pastoral care and basic first aid as a trained first responder, fostering a safe and compliant residential environment.
Diversity ACT	Canberra, Australia
Project Volunteer	April 2024 – October 2024
Supported the execution of community engagement events, managing logistical planning and stakeholder partnerships to promote LGBTQIA+SB inclusion.
Facilitated relationships with local community organizations, enhancing network growth and fostering a broader culture of diversity and inclusion.
EXTRACURRICULAR INTERESTS
Ongoing interest in sustainable finance, ESG reporting and exploring developments in global financial markets and regulatory trends.
Long distance hiking and travelling, with a focus on cultural and natural landscapes.
Tennis & cricket.
Reading science-fiction and non-fiction books across history and geopolitics.
